latest_release.body:
## Fixes

* fix(registry): ignore advertised rate limits slower than one request per 30 seconds by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3913
* fix(registry): wait only for the part of a rate-limit token not yet earned by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3915
* fix(ephemeral): log the DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY value the orchestrator receives by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3917
* fix(notify): print porcelain output only for session reports by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3921
* fix(rebuild): report no-restart compose builds with their built image by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3923
* fix(cmd): handle stop signals in one place by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3927
* fix: keep the caller's context in detached Docker calls by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3939
* fix(git): send Git credentials to self-hosted clone hosts by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3949
* fix(git): treat fully qualified Git hosts as equal by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3963
* fix(git): share one hostname rule for Git hosts by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3966
* fix(git): leave ls-remote time when a Git API stalls by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3978
* fix(update): recreate containers that join a recreated container's network by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3991
* fix(settings): warn when revive-stopped is set without include-stopped by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3998
* fix(container): leave out the shm size for host and none IPC modes by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/4003
* fix(update): start containers again when their removal fails by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/4007
* fix(selfupdate): keep the network container when ephemeral self-update replaces watchtower by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/4011
* fix(update): stop reporting a session canceled by shutdown as failed by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/4020
* fix(container): identify watchtower in a shared network namespace by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/4023
* fix(update): restart a network container after its rename back times out by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/4028
* fix(container): stop guessing among containers that share watchtower's hostname by @nicholas-fedor in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/4035

## Dependency Updates

* chore(deps): update module github.com/gofiber/contrib/v3/swaggo to v1.0.18 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3968
* chore(deps): update module github.com/gofiber/contrib/v3/zerolog to v1.1.12 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3969
* chore(deps): update module github.com/moby/buildkit to v0.35.1 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3974
* chore(deps): update module github.com/klauspost/compress to v1.20.5 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3987
* chore(deps): update github.com/moby/extensions digest to fb779cf by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3989
* chore(deps): update module go.opentelemetry.io/auto/sdk to v1.2.2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/3993
* chore(deps): update module github.com/valyala/fasthttp to v1.80.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/pull/4001

# Watchtower Automate Docker container image updates

[![All Contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/all-contributors/nicholas-fedor/watchtower)](#contributors) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/branch/main/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/nicholas-fedor/watchtower) [![Pulls from DockerHub](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/nickfedor/watchtower.svg)](https://hub.docker.com/r/nickfedor/watchtower) [![GoDoc](https://godoc.org/github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower?status.svg)](https://godoc.org/github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower) [![Ask DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/badge.svg)](https://deepwiki.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower) [![Apache-2.0 License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/nicholas-fedor/watchtower.svg)](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) [![latest version](https://img.shields.io/github/tag/nicholas-fedor/watchtower.svg)](https://github.com/nicholas-fedor/watchtower/releases)
## Quick Start With watchtower you can update the running version of your containerized app simply by pushing a new image to the Docker Hub or your own image registry. Watchtower will pull down your new image, gracefully shut down your existing container and restart it with the same options that were used when it was deployed initially. Run the watchtower container with the following command: ```console $ docker run --detach \ --name watchtower \ --volume /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \ nickfedor/watchtower ``` Watchtower is intended to be used in homelabs, media centers, local dev environments, and similar. We do **not** recommend using Watchtower in a commercial or production environment. If that is you, you should be looking into using Kubernetes enabled with CI/CD, such as onedr0p's Talos Linux with FluxCD setup [here](https://github.com/onedr0p/cluster-template). **⚠️ Note:** It is recommended to use the latest version of Docker. You can check your host's Docker version using the [CLI command](https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/docker/version/) `docker version`. This version of Watchtower has been tested to support v1.43 and higher; however, don't be surprised if you experience unexpected behavior when attempting to use newer features on older versions of Docker. This version autonegotiates the API version by default. If the `DOCKER_API_VERSION` [variable](https://watchtower.nickfedor.com/configuration/docker-connection/#docker_api_version) is explicitly set, Watchtower validates the version and falls back to autonegotiation on failure. ## Supported Architectures Watchtower supports the following architectures for its Docker images: - amd64 - i386 - armhf - arm64v8 - riscv64 ## Documentation The full documentation is available at . ## Star History ## Contributors Thanks goes to these wonderful people ([emoji key](https://allcontributors.org/en/reference/emoji-key/)):
